pointers.sentence: A `ChangeList` is made for each request and does all of this in its `__init__`, so the view receives it built and counted (`django/contrib/admin/views/main.py:ChangeList.__init__`).

`ModelAdmin.get_changelist_instance` reads the hooks (`ModelAdmin.get_list_display` and the others), puts `"action_checkbox"` in front of the columns when the user has an action for the change list, and makes the class `ModelAdmin.get_changelist` returns (`django/contrib/admin/options.py:ModelAdmin.get_changelist_instance`).

`DisallowedModelAdminLookup` and `DisallowedModelAdminToField` are not caught: they are `SuspiciousOperation`s, which the handler answers with 400 ([How an exception becomes a response](../handlers/exceptions.md)) (`django/contrib/admin/options.py:ModelAdmin.changelist_view`).
Every other key is a lookup (`django/contrib/admin/views/main.py:ChangeList.get_filters_params`).
The documentation gives the reason: the lookups can be written by the user, and "they must be sanitized to prevent unauthorized data exposure" (`docs/ref/contrib/admin/index.txt`).
First of all it admits the lookups, value and all, by which a foreign key to the model limits its choices, which raw-id popups send (`django/contrib/admin/options.py:BaseModelAdmin.lookup_allowed`).
`ChangeList.get_queryset` builds the queryset in a fixed order (`django/contrib/admin/views/main.py:ChangeList.get_queryset`).
The leftovers go through `prepare_lookup_value`, which splits an `"__in"` value at its commas and makes an `"__isnull"` value a boolean (`django/contrib/admin/views/main.py:ChangeList.get_filters`).
A list or tuple joins what it names (`django/contrib/admin/views/main.py:ChangeList.apply_select_related`, `django/contrib/admin/views/main.py:ChangeList.get_select_related_fields`).

A false `list_select_related` used to join every non-null foreign key when `list_display` named one, and now joins only those it names (`docs/releases/6.1.txt`, `docs/ref/contrib/admin/index.txt`).

The queryset's own ordering is added, and `"-pk"` last unless `QuerySet.totally_ordered` finds the ordering total, so that, as the docstring says, the order is deterministic ([Annotations, ordering and the other methods that change the query](../querysets/methods.md)) (`django/contrib/admin/views/main.py:ChangeList.get_ordering`).

`QuerySet.distinct` is added when it may, or a field's filter or a leftover may: `lookup_spawns_duplicates` follows a path and answers yes where it crosses a many-to-many or a reverse foreign key. home__name does not; a search of ports by their ships' names would (`django/contrib/admin/utils.py:lookup_spawns_duplicates`).

Unless `BaseModelAdmin.show_full_result_count` is false it counts `root_queryset` too, for the total beside a filtered count, a query the documentation warns is costly on a large table (`docs/ref/contrib/admin/index.txt`).

A list that fits one page, or one asked for with `"all"` and no longer than `list_max_show_all`, 200 by default, is the whole queryset; any other is `Paginator.page` of the page number, and an `InvalidPage` becomes `IncorrectLookupParameters` ([Pagination: `Paginator` and `Page`](../services/pagination.md)) (`django/contrib/admin/views/main.py:ChangeList.get_results`).
